{{Otheruses|Hawk}}
A '''hawk''' was a predatory bird, known for speed and keen eyesight.

==Biology==
Hawks ate small prey such as [[Sparrow/Legends|sparrows]]. There were a variety of different species on numerous worlds.

==History==
[[File:Hawkcustomhelmet.png|thumb|250px|Hawk, with his hawk helmet insignia.]]
Some vehicles, like the ''[[Ebon Hawk]]'', were named after this creature. The [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|clone trooper pilot]] [[Hawk/Legends|Hawk]] had a red hawk insignia on his helmet. The word was used as first name by the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] and [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] [[Hawk Carrow]].<ref name="Regina">{{WEGCite|story=Regina Cayli (adventure)|book=Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game (first edition)}}</ref> [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] believed that [[Dooku/Legends|Darth Tyranus]] had a face like a hawk.<ref name="Boba Fett: The Fight to Survive">''[[Boba Fett: The Fight to Survive]]''</ref>

An elite group of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Cold assault stormtrooper|snowtroopers]] were named the [[Snow Hawks]].

"Hawk" was often used in the name of independent [[Starship/Legends|starships]] operating throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="SS">{{GamerCite|1|Shipbuilding Secrets}}</ref>
